title: Recalibrate bars before reusing them
statement: Don't carry pass bars, yields or thresholds measured on one course or grade over to another; recalibrate them on a control set there first.
detail: The bars and yields at hand for a grade 3 reading course had been derived from a grade 5 one, and the practice spec makes a grade 3 recalibration control set a blocking precondition before any grade 3 gate or generation budget goes live, since historical grade 5 volume does not validate a grade 3 estimate (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/practice-layer-spec.md`). The grade 3 practice criteria repeat it for every threshold and yield (`ti-courseplans-audit/skills/g3-reading-red-team/references/dimensions/D6-practice-durable-mastery.md`).

evidence.quote: All historical G5-derived bars and yields require a **G3 recalibration control set before any G3 gate or generation budget goes live** (blocking precondition)
Historical G5 volume does not validate a G3 estimate.
Every G5-derived threshold/yield is recalibrated on a G3 control set before any G3 gate goes live
`certification_yield` 0.5 is a historical G5 pricing prior (campaign 48.7%), not a G3 readiness result.
A G3 calibration remains blocking before generation or a G3 gate goes live.
**Do not reuse the older 95% macro-F1 / 99% critical-rule-recall threshold here.**
a **G3 recalibration is a blocking precondition** before any G3 gate goes live.
